title: Power and everyday performance
summary: Feedback on power is split between praise for adequate or responsive everyday performance and complaints that some versions feel lacking, while many short fragments mention power without a clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews say the car has enough or responsive power for daily driving, with some also linking it to comfort or strong high-speed performance.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe the car as lacking power or feeling underpowered compared with expectations.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention extra power, controlled power, or comparisons with other cars, but the brief wording often does not make the speaker's evaluation clear.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are very short, which limits confidence in interpreting the specific reason behind comments about power.
The topic includes both clear judgments and vague mentions of power, so not all examples support a precise thematic summary beyond general performance impressions.
Examples are insufficient to determine how comments differ by trim, engine output, or driving context.
